Beyond the named execution fault, a field read of class where comp-heat emits band, and a join keyed on basename that matched 0 of 1774 corpus names. outcomes.note: COVERED, and the two cells serving it disagreed productively. OS-s-15 decided none of the engine O2/O4 legs is a retire candidate and that OS-s-16 is a WIRE rather than a build -- reached with a two-engine falsifier rather than by reasoning about the substitute, and with a positive control on every zero. OS-s-16 then built the roll-up and DISARMED the row OS-s-15 had deferred to it, on the real corpus: the flat grouping lists 1412 cold leaf dirs, the roll-up finds 364 maximal cold subtrees, and 50 OF THOSE 364 ROOTS NEVER APPEAR IN THE FLAT LIST AT ALL. The advisory ranking runs and 0 of 5 top candidates reached RECOMMEND -- all HOLD_REFERENCED -- so nothing in this estate is proposed for archive today. NEVER-AUTO-DELETE WAS ENFORCED RATHER THAN ASSERTED: a RED mutant spliced a recursive delete into a copy of the tool, removed 8 files from its OWN throwaway tree, and the snapshot caught it; every mutant runs against a temporary repository so a mutant that deletes cannot reach the estate. ONE OPEN DEFECT THE GRADER SHOULD WEIGH (W1-S23, ARMED): the inbound-reference check matches a candidate path as a BARE SUBSTRING, so a shallow candidate can essentially never reach RECOMMEND whatever its true reference count. Direction is over-HOLD, so R-5 is not breached. The assignee HELD the grant and still declined to change it, because anchoring the pattern reduces conservatism on the exact axis R-5 governs -- a ruling first and a measured change second.
